note: Recorded from a throwaway local devnet-2 (pointcast-devnet-2 code, 15-minute lot day, GET reads only). It holds real bids, a refund, a settled lot, notary stamps and time capsules. No value.

status.anchors: none: the devnet does not anchor to Tezos
status.label: devnet-2 · bot · unmoderated
status.terms: no value is promised · may reset
status.shared_root: On the devnet, the rotation admin, the other admins and the sequencer all come from one root key that Claude generated. A rotation demo shows the mechanism, not security.

passkeys.note: passkeys work only on these origins (https://pointcast.xyz/chain/first-mints)

rotation.note: the Worker seals only when there is traffic (or a 5-minute heartbeat), so the notice is stated in blocks; eta_ms is at the observed rate

daily.copy: Daily Mint · play auction · devnet play ATTN · no value · may reset
daily.note: Every bid, refund and mint is a block anyone can check. The house can refuse your bid; it can't keep it without leaving evidence. Not detectable: a bid the house never let in.
daily.how_to_bid: 1) POST /daily/faucet {address} once for play ATTN. 2) Optional: sign a publish_block on channel DLY titled "bid/v1 NNNN WORD WORD WORD" (words from the lexicon; add to=<address> to gift the card). 3) Sign a transfer of at least min_bid to the auctioneer and POST /tx. Outbid or invalid inflows come back in the next block.
